name: What information should I have ready before asking for a repair quote?

mainEntity.name: What information should I have ready before asking for a repair quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: Good evidence includes clear photos, a short description of the issue, and any history of when the problem started. For example, a sticking door, cracked caulk, or a drywall hole is easier to quote accurately when the handyman can see the size, location, and surrounding materials.
acceptedAnswer.description: Have photos, the room or location, a description of the problem, and when it started so the repair can be quoted more accurately.
